changes: 1. Project migration from JavaScript to TypeScript
2. Added support for 8 languages: English (default), Russian, Japanese, German, Portuguese, Spanish, Hindi, French
3. Connected Supabase as the primary database
4. Added in-memory caching of guild settings for 60 seconds with invalidation on changes
5. The /config command received subcommands: language, modules, birthdays, logging, currency
6. Implemented configuration of the birthday announcement channel and status
7. Implemented configuration of the logging channel and status
8. Economic system change: transition from a decentralized economy to a default one
9. Implemented changing the currency emoji and name
10. Mod embeds brought to a unified style: title «Action — user», description mentioning the moderator and target, reason field, target avatar in thumbnail
11. Added a restriction on some actions against yourself
12. Written the /about command with canvas ping graph generation and CPU and RAM statistics
13. Written the /birthday command with subcommands set, view, delete
14. Connected node-cron: daily at 09:00 UTC the bot checks birthday users and congratulates them in the configured channel
15. Written the leaderboard command with pagination across 5 pages
16. Written the marriage command with subcommands propose and divorce and confirmation buttons
17. Added the ability to customize the currency via /config currency
18. Extended the Francesca character prompt: main character backstory, command hints, added Tavily for information search
19. Reduced the limit for containers (confessions) to 15MB
20. Connected Shoukaku as the Lavalink v4 client
